function.description: Send the Vex Inference deposit that VexInferenceDepositPrepare prepared. This SPENDS REAL FUNDS: it signs with the user's wallet and broadcasts an IRREVERSIBLE VEX transfer on Robinhood Chain to the pinned deposit address. In the app Vex calls it for you right after the prepare, so do not call it yourself. AUTHORITY: in a restricted session the user approves a card showing every line (amount, wallet, deposit address, fee bound, expiry); a full-permission session executes directly; during a mission the same rules apply under the mission's wallet scope. Without a card it runs only when the user's own auto top-up rule covers it (same wallet, at most the rule's amount, within its daily count and 30-day cap); otherwise it answers needs_user_approval. You cannot create, widen or reuse authority. BEFORE IT SIGNS it re-checks the session wallet, the inventory, the account link, the pinned address against the backend, the minimum, the balances, the fee bound, the expiry and the vault; any drift REFUSES BY NAME with nothing signed. RETURNS a DISTINCT outcome: confirmed (txHash, transferProven, authority), reverted on chain, broadcast with the outcome UNKNOWN, or refused before broadcast; only the last is safe to prepare again. An unknown one is recorded and counted against any rule cap and is NEVER re-sent; neither should you.
function.name: VexInferenceDepositConfirm

intentId.description: The intentId VexInferenceDepositPrepare returned (starts with `vxdep-`). Scoped to this session and single use.
